notes.title: Free RemiLore Costume DLC!
notes.notes:
New FREE DLC is available now for RemiLore! This update adds 30+ fun new costumes, including festive holiday attire, stylish beachwear, and a number of professional uniforms! Or you can choose to cosplay as several fan favorite characters from other games, including Quote and Curly from Cave Story, Umihara Kawase and her friends, and even several characters from The Binding of Isaac! 

This DLC is free and available to everyone who owns the game, no microtransactions or unlock conditions required. Simply download the update and go explore Ragnoah in style!

notes.title: RemiLore is Out Now! Read Here for Info on Known PC Configuration Issues
notes.notes:
We are excited that RemiLore is officially available on Steam! We have found that certain PC configurations may hinder the game's optimal performance, and so we wanted to post the details and solutions to those issues here, to help any players who may happen to encounter them.

1. If you are having controller issues, such as button inputs registering twice, or a single gamepad controlling both Player 1 and Player 2, please check to see if you are running DS4Windows. RemiLore is not compatible with this software; if you disable it, your controllers should work correctly.

2. The initial loading time for the game should take about 30 to 90 seconds, but if it is taking much longer than that, it might be conflicting with your Power settings for Windows. Try setting the Windows Power setting to 'High' - the Standard or Low settings can reduce CPU clock speed, which can sometimes significantly affect load times. Laptop computers may be more likely to encounter this issue.

If you should happen to run into any other technical issues with the game, please make a community post here and describe your issue in as much detail as you can. And have fun exploring the Lands of Lore!
